verdict.rationale: Integrating end-to-end testing tools is a fair question for a web framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions Next.js testing guides, official E2E tool integrations (e.g., Playwright or Cypress), or test runners working with the dev server. The pack covers routing, rendering, styling, an MCP endpoint and OpenTelemetry, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate official end-to-end testing tools that work out of the box with the framework's dev server
